topic: Picking a Gift for a Friend

script.title: PICKING A BIRTHDAY GIFT
script.scene_zh: 禮品店 · 挑生日禮物
script.story_hook: A last-minute shopper hunts for the perfect gift.
script.intro_zh: 臨時出門的人，正在找一份剛剛好的生日禮物。
script.welcome_en: Hey friends, welcome back! Today we're picking a birthday gift.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，朋友們，歡迎回來！今天我們來挑生日禮物。
script.outro: That's the gift, wrapped! Listen again and repeat with me.
script.outro_zh: 禮物包好啦！再聽一次，跟著我唸。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn: listen and say it loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你：聽一遍，大聲說出來。
script.char_a_description: a slim woman in her mid-twenties with a blunt chestnut bob and a small silver nose ring, wearing an olive parka over a striped long-sleeve tee, shifting a shopping bag between hands
script.char_b_description: a gentle older man approaching sixty with silver side-parted hair and a tidy white mustache, wearing a burgundy store vest with a name tag, folding tissue paper neatly
script.youtube_title: 【🎁✨挑禮物英文】「just in case」怎麼說？預算、包裝、贈品收據一次學會｜🎧Birthday Gift English
script.youtube_title_en: "Just In Case" — Picking a Birthday Gift for a Close Friend
script.youtube_description:
朋友生日要到了，禮物還沒著落？這段禮品店裡的真實對話，教你講預算、請店員推薦、要包裝與收據。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽完就能自己挑好禮物。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱我們的頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成你的直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
Friend's birthday coming up and no gift yet? This gift-shop conversation teaches you to name a budget, ask for suggestions, and request wrapping plus a gift receipt. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA and Traditional Chinese, then a repeat-after-me section so you can shop in English.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎁挑生日禮物英文｜講預算・請店員推薦・要收據包裝｜聽完就會買｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
朋友生日就在眼前，禮物毫無頭緒？
「預算大概三十塊」用英文怎麼講？
想要包裝和收據，要怎麼開口？

這一集帶大家走進一家溫馨的禮品店，跟著臨時出門的顧客從報預算、排除重複的東西，到請店員推薦、要包裝與贈品收據，全程都是自然的日常美式英語。

你會聽到：
💬 講預算與喜好：例如「what's your budget?」、「Around thirty dollars, maybe a bit more.」。
🤔 排除與挑選：例如「She owns one already.」、「Something else?」。
🎀 包裝與收據：例如「Do you wrap free?」、「here's a gift receipt just in case.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把挑禮物的對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次走進禮品店，你也能三兩句就挑到剛剛好的那份禮物！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a small diffuser box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need a birthday gift, and fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid ə ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ ɡɪft ənd fæst/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要一份生日禮物，而且要快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy to help. Who's the lucky person?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi tə hɛlp huːz ðə ˈlʌki ˈpɜrsən/
dialogue.zh: 很樂意幫忙。是哪位幸運的人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend Nina. She's into cozy stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd ˈninə ʃiz ˈɪntu ˈkoʊzi stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 我朋友 Nina，她喜歡溫暖舒適的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Candles, blankets, mugs... what's your budget?
dialogue.zh: 蠟燭、毛毯、馬克杯……預算大概多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Around thirty dollars, maybe a bit more.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ˈθɜrti ˈdɑlərz ˈmeɪbi ə bɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 大概三十塊，也許再多一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This wool throw is thirty-five, on sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʊl θroʊ ɪz ˈθɜrti faɪv ɑn seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 這條羊毛毯三十五塊，正在特價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lovely color, but she owns one already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli ˈkʌlər bʌt ʃi ˈoʊnz wʌn ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 顏色很美，不過她已經有一條了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair point. Well, what about this mug set?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr pɔɪnt wɛl wʌt əˈbaʊt ðɪs mʌɡ sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 說得也是。那這組馬克杯呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She has a hundred mugs. Something else?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ə ˈhʌndrəd mʌɡz ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 她有一百個杯子欸。還有別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This little diffuser sells out every month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈlɪtəl dɪˈfjuzər sɛlz aʊt ˈɛvri mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 這個小擴香每個月的量都賣到缺貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, is that hard to use, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ɪz ðæt hɑrd tə juz ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那個用起來會不會很麻煩？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all. Two buttons, that's it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ɔl tu ˈbʌtənz ðæts ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一點都不會。兩個按鈕，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll take it. Do you wrap free?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl teɪk ɪt du ju ˈræp fri/
dialogue.zh: 好，我要這個。包禮物是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and here's a gift receipt just in case.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ənd hɪrz ə ɡɪft rɪˈsit dʒʌst ɪn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，我們會附一張贈品收據，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can you write happy birthday inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt kæn ju raɪt ˈhæpi ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。可以在裡面寫生日快樂嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just 'Nina', right? No last name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr dʒʌst ˈninə raɪt noʊ læst neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 可以，只寫 Nina 對吧？不用姓？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just Nina. Thanks for saving my birthday.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ˈninə θæŋks fɔr ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ ˈbɜrθˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就寫 Nina。謝謝你救了我的生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! She'll love that one, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！她一定會喜歡這一份的。
